City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
SEPTEMBER 12, 2006
7:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Perez, Chavez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF COMMENDATION TO ST. LOUIS OF FRANCE SCHOOL IN CELEBRATION OF THE SCHOOL’S GOLDEN JUBILEE (to be presented on September 16, 2006)
Commendation
PRESENTATION OF COMMENDATION TO THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL IN HONOR OF ITS 50TH ANNIVERSARY PRESENTED BY ANGIE CASTRO, COMMUNITY PRESS DEPUTY FOR SUPERVISOR GLORIA MOLINA
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 98-767).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1.
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF AUGUST 22, 2006
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of August 22, 2006.
Minutes 8-22-06
PUBLIC HEARINGS
None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1186 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
Warrant Register No. 1186
D-2
APPROVAL OF NEW PARTICIPANT(S) FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FOR ROUND TWO FUNDING
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Community Development Director to execute the necessary documents to implement the Housing Rehabilitation Program in the amount of $40,000.
CalHome Rehabilitation Report
D-3
ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING TITLE 10, CHAPTER 10.12, SECTION 10.12.1120 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE CHANGING THE ZONE DESIGNATION OF THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1103 LARIMORE AVENUE FROM R-1 (ONE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL) TO R-3 (MULTIPLE RESIDENTIAL) (Introduced and title read at meeting of August 22, 2006)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the ordinance amending Title 10, Chapter 10.12, Section 10.12.1120 of the La Puente Municipal Code.
Adoption of Ord. Report
Draft Ordinance
D-4
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR PURCHASE OF CITY VEHICLES
It is recommended that City Council authorize Staff to solicit bids for the purchase of a new 2007 Ford Escape Hybrid FWD and designate Monday, October 2, 2006 at 10:00 a.m. as the deadline for receiving bids.
Solicite Bids for Vehicle Report
Vehicle Bid
D-5
ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING TIRE-DERIVED PRODUCT GRANT APPLICATION FOR THE PUENTE CREEK NATURE EDUCATION CENTER
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution authorizing the submittal of an application to the California Integrated Waste Management Board Tire-Derived Product Grant Program for FY 2006-2007 for the Puente Creek Nature Education Center and authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute all necessary applications, contracts, agreements, amendments and payment requests as specified in the grant application.
Tire-Derived Product Applic. Report
Tire-Derived Product Grant Resolution
D-6
PROJECT ACCEPTANCE FOR "ZONE 5" SLURRY SEAL PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council accept completion of the Slurry Seal Zone 5 Project and authorize the City Clerk to record the Notice of Completion with the Los Angeles County Clerk Recorder.
"Zone 5" Proj. Acceptance Report
"Zone 5" Notice of Completion
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
STATUS REPORT AND PRESENTATION FROM PRIMESTOR DEVELOPMENT ON THE PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT OF THE LA PUENTE LANES AND VICINITY (generally located on Hacienda Boulevard between Fairgrove and Maplegrove Street)
It is recommended that the City Council permit the representatives from Primestor to present an update on their proposed development plans for the La Puente lanes site and vicinity.
Primestor Development Report
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR PROPOSITIONS 1A THROUGH 1E
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution supporting Propositions 1A through 1E as passed by the State Legislature and signed by Governor Schwarzenegger and as recommended by the League of California Cities.
Support Propostions 1A through E1
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING A POLICY FOR PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES, COMMENDATIONS, PROCLAMATIONS, PLAQUES AND OTHER RECOGNITION AWARDS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Policy Guidelines for Recognition Requests.
Policy of Presentation Cert....
Proposed Policy
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING PROPOSITION 84: CLEAN WATER, PARKS AND COASTAL PROTECTION BOND
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution supporting Proposition 84 Clean Water, Parks and Costal Protection Bond and forward copies to The Nature Conservancy and the California Conservation Action Fund and the League of California Cities.
Propostion 84 Report
Proposition 84 Resolution
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF DISSOLUTION OF THE POLICE-COMMUNITY RELATIONS COMMITTEE AND ESTABLISHMENT OF A "NEIGHBORHOOD WATCH" COMMITTEE
It is recommended that the City Council dissolve the Police-Community Relations Committee and establish a Neighborhood Watch Committee as an ad-hoc committee with five members, serving on a voluntary basis to establish a Neighborhood Watch Program in La Puente.
PCRC and Neighborhood Watch Report
Resolution
E-6
CONSIDERATION OF LETTER IN SUPPORT OF SHERIFF BACA’S PROPOSAL TO MODIFY THE HOMELAND SECURITY GRANT STRUCTURE
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to sign and forward the proposed letter of support to Sheriff Leroy Baca.
Support Sheriff Baca's Report
Letter
E-7
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZING COUNCIL ATTENDANCE AT THE CONGRESSIONAL HISPANIC CAUCUS INSTITUTE PUBLIC POLICY CONFERENCE (Requested by Council Member Lujan)
None.
Congressional Hispanic Caucus Report
E-8
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING THE POLICY ALLOWING PORTABLE BARBEQUES AT LA PUENTE PARK BY PARK PATRONS (Requested by Council Member Solis)
None. COUNCIL REPORTS
Barbeques at Park Report
COUNCIL REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 538. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk’s Office. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
* Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727, effective September 7, 1995.)
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
minutes_text:
City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
September 12, 2006
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on September 12, 2006, at 7:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF COMMENDATION TO ST. LOUIS OF FRANCE SCHOOL IN CELEBRATION OF THE SCHOOL’S GOLDEN JUBILEE (to be presented on September 16, 2006)
Commendation
PRESENTATION OF COMMENDATION TO THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL IN HONOR OF ITS 50TH ANNIVERSARY PRESENTED BY ANGIE CASTRO, COMMUNITY PRESS DEPUTY FOR SUPERVISOR GLORIA MOLINA
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1.
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF AUGUST 22, 2006
Minutes 8-22-06
Solis moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of August 22, 2006 ; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken :
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
Lujan moved to approve Consent Calendar Items D-1 through D-6; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1186 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
Warrant Register No. 1186
D-2
APPROVAL OF NEW PARTICIPANT(S) FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FOR ROUND TWO FUNDING
CalHome Rehabilitation Report
D-3
ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING TITLE 10, CHAPTER 10.12, SECTION 10.12.1120 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE CHANGING THE ZONE DESIGNATION OF THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1103 LARIMORE AVENUE FROM R-1 (ONE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL) TO R-3 (MULTIPLE RESIDENTIAL) (Introduced and title read at meeting of August 22, 2006)
Adoption of Ord. Report
Draft Ordinance
D-4
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR PURCHASE OF CITY VEHICLES
Solicite Bids for Vehicle Report
Vehicle Bid
D-5
ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING TIRE-DERIVED PRODUCT GRANT APPLICATION FOR THE PUENTE CREEK NATURE EDUCATION CENTER
Tire-Derived Product Applic. Report
Tire-Derived Product Grant Resolution
D-6
PROJECT ACCEPTANCE FOR "ZONE 5" SLURRY SEAL PROJECT
"Zone 5" Proj. Acceptance Report
"Zone 5" Notice of Completion
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
STATUS REPORT AND PRESENTATION FROM PRIMESTOR DEVELOPMENT ON THE PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT OF THE LA PUENTE LANES AND VICINITY (generally located on Hacienda Boulevard between Fairgrove and Maplegrove Street)
Primestor Development Report
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR PROPOSITIONS 1A THROUGH 1E
Support Propostions 1A through E1
Lujan moved to adopt a resolution supporting Propositions 1A through 1E as passed by the State Legislature and signed by Governor Schwarzenegger and as recommended by the League of California Cities; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING A POLICY FOR PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES, COMMENDATIONS, PROCLAMATIONS, PLAQUES AND OTHER RECOGNITION AWARDS
Policy of Presentation Cert....
Proposed Policy
Perez moved to adopt the Policy Guidelines for Recognition Requests ; seconded by Chavez.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: Solis, and Storing.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING PROPOSITION 84: CLEAN WATER, PARKS AND COASTAL PROTECTION BOND
Propostion 84 Report
Proposition 84 Resolution
Perez moved to adopt the resolution supporting Proposition 84 Clean Water, Parks and Costal Protection Bond and forward copies to The Nature Conservancy and the California Conservation Action Fund and the League of California Cities; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF DISSOLUTION OF THE POLICE-COMMUNITY RELATIONS COMMITTEE AND ESTABLISHMENT OF A "NEIGHBORHOOD WATCH" COMMITTEE
PCRC and Neighborhood Watch Report
Resolution
Lujan moved to dissolve the Police-Community Relations Committee and establish a Neighborhood Watch Committee as an ad-hoc committee with five members, serving on a voluntary basis to establish a Neighborhood Watch Program in La Puente; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-6
CONSIDERATION OF LETTER IN SUPPORT OF SHERIFF BACA’S PROPOSAL TO MODIFY THE HOMELAND SECURITY GRANT STRUCTURE
Support Sheriff Baca's Report
Letter
Lujan moved to authorize the Mayor to sign and forward the proposed letter of support to Sheriff Leroy Baca; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-7
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZING COUNCIL ATTENDANCE AT THE CONGRESSIONAL HISPANIC CAUCUS INSTITUTE PUBLIC POLICY CONFERENCE (Requested by Council Member Lujan)
Congressional Hispanic Caucus Report
Lujan moved to authorize Council attendance at the Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute Public Policy Conference; seconded by Perez.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: Storing.
E-8
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING THE POLICY ALLOWING PORTABLE BARBEQUES AT LA PUENTE PARK BY PARK PATRONS (Requested by Council Member Solis)
Barbeques at Park Report
Solis moved to refer this item to Staff to evaluate this issue including 5 miles per hour speed limits, and dogs on leashes and bring back to Council for consideration; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
COUNCIL REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
Approved this
_________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC
City Clerk/Secretary
_________________________________
Charlie Klinakis
Mayor/Chair
